subject: Marketplace renewal — Globex geo-tiered capacity & term amendment
messages:
From: Alice Martin <alice.martin@globex.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@globex.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 15:03:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal request — region split & term change

Hi Jonas,

We're preparing to finalize our renewal for the coming year and have a couple of changes we'd like to propose so this lines up with our procurement windows across regions. High level:

- Term: we'd like to move from a 12-month to an 18-month term (start date 2028-06-01) so our budget aligns with a multi-quarter program.
- Capacity: increase committed spend in US and EU. Proposed monthly commitments: US $55k / month, EU $30k / month, APAC remains ad-hoc (no commit).
- Marketplace/private offers: we prefer the US region be handled via an AWS Marketplace private offer (so we can consume through our AWS account and have a Marketplace invoice). For EU we'd like either Azure Marketplace private offer or a Redwood direct invoice — whichever is simpler for split invoicing.

Can you confirm Redwood can support: separate POs per region, split invoicing (Marketplace invoice for US), and an 18-month amendment? If so, procurement will issue an initial PO for the US Marketplace tranche and a second PO for the EU commitment. I've attached a short doc with our requested terms.

Thanks,
Alice Martin
Sr. Procurement Manager
Globex Corp
[Attachment: Globex_Renewal_Request_20280520.docx (DOCX, 64KB)]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Martin <alice.martin@globex.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal request — region split & term change

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. We can support the model you're asking for, but there are a few operational details to confirm so finance and marketplace operations can put the offers in place cleanly:

1) Term & effective dates: 18 months starting 2028-06-01 works. We'll prepare an amendment that ties both private offers/POs back to the same Redwood master subscription.

2) Split invoicing: AWS Marketplace private offer can handle the US PO and produce the Marketplace invoice. For EU, we can either route through Azure Marketplace private offer or issue a Redwood direct invoice tied to the EU PO. If Globex needs vendor-specific VAT handling, we should pick the Azure private offer option. Please confirm which you prefer.

3) Capacity mapping: can you confirm whether the $ numbers are monthly committed spend or expected monthly consumption? We'll map them to the commit tranches for the private offer.

4) Timeline: if you send the US PO this week we'll initiate the AWS private offer creation and send the Private Offer ID back for purchase. Legal/Finance will need the signed PO to attach.

I'll loop in Ben (marketplace ops) and Kimberly (finance) to scope the PO routing and any billing changes. Can we have a 30-minute call tomorrow to align on preferred invoicing for EU and sign-off cadence?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Ben / Kimberly — forwarding Globex's renewal note. Key asks: 18-month term starting 6/1, US via AWS private offer (they'll send a PO), EU wants either Azure private offer or a Redwood invoice (they're leaning Azure for VAT). Proposed mapping (we should validate pricing):

- US (AWS private offer): monthly commit $55,000 
- EU (Azure private offer or Redwood invoice): monthly commit $30,000
- APAC: no commit, usage-based fallback

If we accept these commitments over 18 months, the total committed contract value would be: (55k + 30k) * 18 = $1,530,000.

Action items I think we need:
- Ben: confirm AWS private offer flow + estimate lead time to have Private Offer IDs (we'll need separate IDs if we do AWS + Azure). Also confirm whether Marketplace billing will allow a PO per tranche and mark the offer to generate Marketplace invoices to Globex.
- Kimberly: confirm Redwood's ability to invoice EU region directly if they decide not to use Azure marketplace, and advise on VAT handling/required forms.
- Marissa: any concerns on SLA or capacity routing (region pinning) we need to call out in the amendment?

Attaching a quick capacity worksheet I used to map the numbers — helps finance/ops run the quotes.
